text:
Opens a Key-Value Storage.
OpenKeyValueStorage will fail with kResourceBusy when the Key-Value Storage is currently
being modified by a call from another thread to UpdatePersistency, CleanUpPersistency, Reset
Persistency, RecoverKeyValueStorage, or ResetKeyValueStorage.
Because multiple threads can access the same Key-Value Storage concurrently, the Key-Value
Storage might not be closed when the SharedHandle returned by this function goes out of
scope. It will only be closed when all SharedHandles that refer to the same Key-Value Storage
went out of scope.
